prs.title: fix(shared): handle objects without a prototype in looseEqual (fix #16250)
prs.author: pengzh1
prs.body:
Fixes #16250

Passing a fresh raw null-prototype object as a component's style can throw during the update check. `looseEqual` assumes that compared objects provide `hasOwnProperty`, and its final `String()` comparison also fails when a null-prototype object has no conversion methods.

Use the existing `hasOwn` helper for key checks. After comparing keys and values, use `toTypeString` as a fallback only for null-prototype objects without `Symbol.toPrimitive`, a callable `toString`, or a callable `valueOf`. All other objects retain the existing `String()` comparison, including class instances and objects with custom coercion. Exceptions thrown by custom conversion methods still propagate.

Matching object tags and enumerable properties does not establish that custom string comparisons are redundant. Keeping that comparison prevents distinct object-valued select options from matching the first option incorrectly.

Reactive style objects can avoid the original component-update failure because vnode normalization copies non-array proxy styles into ordinary objects. The reactivity `hasOwnProperty` interception alone does not make null-prototype objects safe to compare.

Validation:

- Added shared regressions for custom conversion, null-prototype conversion methods, user-thrown errors, and comparisons against RegExp / boxed numbers.
- Added three compiled-template DOM regressions for select values using `toString`, `Symbol.toPrimitive`, and class instances. They check initial sele

prs.title: fix(compiler-sfc): honour user `onWarn` + surface inline template tips
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
a template warning can vanish in a production build of a `<script setup>` component. a warning raised by a user `nodeTransform` (or a compat deprecation) survives in dev but is gone once `NODE_ENV` is `production`.

this is because we spread `compilerOptions` and then overwrite `onWarn`, so a user-supplied warn handler is dropped.

... and with `inlineTemplate`, we compile the template but only feeds the resulting tips to `warnOnce` (a no-op when building) instead of returning them, so `@vitejs/plugin-vue` has nothing to forward.

this PR chains a passed-in `onWarn` and `onError` after the internal collector.

**update**: I've dropped the new `tips` field on `SFCScriptBlock`, and therefore I think it doesn't need a minor release; I'll open a separate PR with a better approach 🙏

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Compiler warning and error callbacks now receive messages emitted during template compilation, while those messages remain available in the compilation result. This ensures diagnostics from template transforms and transformed-template processing are surfaced consistently through the provided callbacks and included in the corresponding result fields.
